# MH-20 — Register a hike

**Business value:** 938

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker
I want to register my planned hike before departure
So that the hut has information that can be used if I do not return as expected

<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

Hike information should include:

- destination (name)
- route (a text description, e.g. "via the Chiaretto lake"),
- intermediate passage points (possible intermediate points, e.g. "Viso Mozzo")

In addition to entering the information it is reasonable to let the hiker select from a few predefined or popular hikes.

When registering the hike it is also required to provide:

- Planned departure date and time
- Expected return date and time
